name: card_findings
doc: Static checks: README present, card matches registry and code, parent README names its sub-modules.

name: resolve_base
doc: The commit the work started from: $SOP_BASE, else the merge-base of HEAD with main. Raises if neither resolves.

name: freshness_findings
doc: A module whose code changed since `base` must also have changed its README, or carry a README waiver.

name: section
doc: Return the section starting at the line `heading` up to (not including) `stop_heading`, or to EOF.

name: sop_version
doc: Return the '**Version:** x.y.z' value of an SOP, or raise ValueError.

name: skill_path
doc: Return the path of a class's MODULE-standard skill inside its class pack.

name: lint
doc: Return a list of violation strings for one SKILL.md.

name: check
doc: Run every structure check. Returns (failures, warnings) as lists of strings.
